questions: Should the output list be sorted in any particular order (e.g., lexicographically, by first element, by second element)?
Is n guaranteed to be an integer, or should the function handle non-integer inputs (e.g., float 2.5)?
Should the function handle very large n values efficiently, or is performance not a concern?
Are pairs allowed to include the same number twice (e.g., (1,1))?
Should the function return an empty list for n=1, or raise an error?
Is the range inclusive of n? (i.e., numbers from 1 to n inclusive?)
Should the output be a list of tuples, or is a list of lists acceptable?
If n is less than 1, what should the error message be? (e.g., generic ValueError vs custom message)
